harness.name: VulnHunter (Capital One)
harness.description: Agentic source-code hunter that reasons like an adversary and drops findings it cannot prove exploitable.

uses.quote: VulnHunter is an open-source, **agentic AI security tool** that applies proactive, attacker-first analysis directly to source code.

| **`/vulnhunter-fix`** | **Fix** | Developer-led, test-driven remediation. It writes an exploit demo, creates a failing security test (**RED**), implements the code fix (**GREEN**), verifies the exploit is blocked without regressions, and cuts a reviewable PR. |
